title: silphium compositum f. orae
intro: Silphium compositum f. orae, commonly known as the Giant Fennel or Silphium, is a plant species that has been extinct for over 2,000 years but its name has been used to describe a plant composite made from various herbs. The health benefits of Silphium compositum include its potential use in digestive issues, as an anti-inflammatory, and its possible effects on menstrual disorders. The therapeutic actions of Silphium compositum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids and other compounds that contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and carminative properties.
